# Process & Planning

Skills that keep the agent disciplined: brainstorm, spec, plan, then execute in small verified steps.

[← All categories](README.md)

<a id="brainstorming"></a>
### Brainstorming

`superpowers:brainstorming` · skill · **core** · phases: Discover, Define

Structured, question-by-question exploration of intent and requirements before any creative or build work starts.

**Use when**
- Starting a new dashboard or a new major feature
- The request is fuzzy ("make it nice", "something like a CRM")

**Avoid when**
- Small, fully specified fixes
- The spec is already approved; go to writing-plans

**How to use**
- Ask one question at a time; propose 2-3 approaches with a recommendation
- Write the agreed design to docs/ before building

**Pairs with:** [Spec-Driven Development](process.md#spec-driven-development) · [Idea Refine](process.md#idea-refine) · [Writing Plans](process.md#writing-plans)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/framework/01-discover.md](../../docs/framework/01-discover.md)

<a id="planning-and-task-breakdown"></a>
### Planning & Task Breakdown

`agent-protocols:planning-and-task-breakdown` · skill · **core** · phases: Define, Build

Breaks a spec into small, ordered, verifiable tasks with dependencies.

**Use when**
- The spec is approved and you need a build order
- A task feels too big to start

**Avoid when**
- There is no spec yet: write one first

**How to use**
- Slice vertically: each task ends in something visible on a preview URL

**Pairs with:** [Writing Plans](process.md#writing-plans) · [Incremental Implementation](build.md#incremental-implementation)

---

<a id="spec-driven-development"></a>
### Spec-Driven Development

`agent-protocols:spec-driven-development` · skill · **core** · phases: Define

Writes a structured specification (goals, users, scope, acceptance criteria, non-goals) before code exists.

**Use when**
- After discovery, before any design or code
- Requirements live only in voice notes or chat

**Avoid when**
- Tiny changes to an existing, documented feature

**How to use**
- Use templates/spec.md as the output shape
- Every v1 feature needs a testable acceptance criterion

**Pairs with:** [Planning & Task Breakdown](process.md#planning-and-task-breakdown) · [Writing Plans](process.md#writing-plans)

**If not installed:** follow [templates/spec.md](../../templates/spec.md)

---

<a id="idea-refine"></a>
### Idea Refine

`agent-protocols:idea-refine` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Discover

Divergent-then-convergent ideation: generates options, then narrows to the strongest with explicit criteria.

**Use when**
- Choosing between dashboard concepts or feature ideas
- The client has many wishes and v1 needs a focus

**Avoid when**
- The direction is already decided

**How to use**
- Feed it the client's goals and constraints; ask for 3 concepts scored against them

**Pairs with:** [Brainstorming](process.md#brainstorming) · [Choose What to Build](research.md#choose-what-to-build)

---

<a id="karpathy-guidelines"></a>
### Karpathy Guidelines

`agent-protocols:karpathy-guidelines` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Build

Behavioral guardrails against common LLM coding mistakes: over-engineering, unrequested changes, hidden assumptions.

**Use when**
- Any coding session, especially when a non-developer client is directing changes

**How to use**
- Make surgical changes; state assumptions; define how success is verified

**Pairs with:** [Incremental Implementation](build.md#incremental-implementation)

---

<a id="writing-plans"></a>
### Writing Plans

`superpowers:writing-plans` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Define, Build

Produces a step-by-step implementation plan file an agent (or a later session) can execute faithfully.

**Use when**
- Multi-session work where context will be lost between sessions
- Handing work to subagents

**Avoid when**
- One-file changes

**How to use**
- Save plans in docs/plans/ so the client's AI can resume later

**Pairs with:** [Executing Plans](process.md#executing-plans) · [Subagent-Driven Development](process.md#subagent-driven-development)

---

<a id="context-engineering"></a>
### Context Engineering

`agent-protocols:context-engineering` · skill · **optional** · phases: Handover

Sets up rules files and context so future agent sessions start with the right knowledge.

**Use when**
- Writing the client project's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
- Agent output quality is degrading over a long project

**How to use**
- Keep always-loaded files short; link to deeper docs

**Pairs with:** [Documentation & ADRs](handover.md#documentation-and-adrs)

---

<a id="executing-plans"></a>
### Executing Plans

`superpowers:executing-plans` · skill · **optional** · phases: Build

Executes a written plan task by task with checkpoints, as the implementer in the current session.

**Use when**
- A plan file exists and you are implementing it yourself

**Avoid when**
- No written plan exists

**How to use**
- Tick tasks off in the plan file as you go

**Pairs with:** [Writing Plans](process.md#writing-plans)

<a id="dispatching-parallel-agents"></a>
### Dispatching Parallel Agents

`superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents` · skill · **situational** · phases: Build, Polish & QA

Fans out 2+ independent tasks (e.g. separate audits) to parallel agents.

**Use when**
- Running UX, accessibility and performance audits at once

**Avoid when**
- Tasks that depend on each other's output

**How to use**
- Give every agent a self-contained brief and expected output format

**Pairs with:** [UX Audit Suite (usability + a11y + journeys)](quality.md#ux-audit-suite)

<a id="subagent-driven-development"></a>
### Subagent-Driven Development

`superpowers:subagent-driven-development` · skill · **situational** · phases: Build

Runs independent plan tasks through fresh subagents with review between tasks.

**Use when**
- Large builds with many independent tasks

**Avoid when**
- Small projects: overhead outweighs benefit
- Tasks that share files heavily

**How to use**
- Use only after the plan is stable

**Pairs with:** [Dispatching Parallel Agents](process.md#dispatching-parallel-agents) · [Writing Plans](process.md#writing-plans)
